# PowerShell completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions powershell`)
$JetCommands = @('registry','inspect','hangar','self','diff','merge','run','check','test','prove','build','dev','debug','repl','import','new','fmt','fix','lint','explain','env','trust','image','os','add','remove','fetch','update','init','clean','emit','eval','budget','bench','fuzz','version','help')
$JetFlags = @('--attach','--once','--observe','--structural','--out','--report','--repo','--json','--color','--version','--check','--diff','--changed','--stdin-path','--small','--task','--locked','--lock','-p','--annotated','--force','--message','--before','--spdx','--cyclonedx','--advisory-db','--vendor-dir','--sbom','--verbose','--online','--fix','--dry-run','--try-anyway','--restart','--swap','--watch','--project','--pure','--freestanding','--allow-impure','--allow-exec','--allow-fs','--allow-net','--allow-env','--allow-io','--allow-db','--allow-time','--allow-rand','--allow-log','--allow-gpu','--target','--explain-partition','--capabilities-json','--update-snapshots','--coverage','--rust','-u','--release','--profile','--a11y','--scope','--filter','--shuffle','--serial','--iterations','--time','--seed','--corpus','--lens','--annotations','--baseline','--bootstrap','--accept-regression','--reason','--yes','-y')
$JetGroups = @{ 'registry' = @('publish','yank','keygen','key','vendor'); 'inspect' = @('live','graph','query','explain-build','impact','dossier','semindex','expand','schema','codemod','audit','sbom','bind','logs','search','info','outdated'); 'hangar' = @('verify','repair','copy','import','export','dump','restore','sign','rollback','generations','du'); 'self' = @('toolchain','upgrade','doctor','completions','man','devtools','lsp'); 'os' = @('push','bridge','services','config') }
Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName jet -ScriptBlock { param($wordToComplete,$commandAst,$cursorPosition) $words = @($commandAst.CommandElements | ForEach-Object { $_.Extent.Text }); $choices = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) { $JetFlags } elseif ($words.Count -ge 2 -and $JetGroups.ContainsKey($words[1])) { $JetGroups[$words[1]] } else { $JetCommands }; $choices | Where-Object { $_ -like "$wordToComplete*" } | ForEach-Object { [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($_,$_,"ParameterValue",$_) } }
